note: Vision-guided IK sorter (hfteama sort ...). Table frame: origin at the centre of tag 0 (front-left, seen from the overhead camera), x to the right towards tag 3, y away from the camera towards tag 2, z up; metres. See docs/hardware/sorter.md.

ignore.note: Never pieces: large dark colourless regions (black arm, wrist cameras, cables; Lab chroma < dark_chroma_max, so a dark blue piece still counts) and green ones (green arm), grown by 'grow' m. OpenCV hue 0..180, Lab L 0..255.

arms_note: Arms are named after their pair. Seen from BEHIND the arms (facing the camera): rakesh (black) is on the right, hacklab (green) on the left. Seen from the camera it is the other way round. base = base_link origin in the table frame.

motion.home_note: Home (camera-clear) pose = the pose the arm has when the sorter connects: leave each arm folded at rest before starting.
